summary.text: Anthony Forlini is the Republican nominee for Michigan Secretary of State and has been Macomb County clerk since 2021. A former Harrison Township supervisor and state representative, he is campaigning on cleaner voter rolls, shorter Secretary of State wait times and more election transparency.

paragraphs.text: Harrison Township supervisor before serving in the Michigan House of Representatives from 2011 to 2016.
Ran for Michigan's 10th Congressional District in 2016, finishing fourth of five in the Republican primary.
Elected Macomb County clerk in 2020 and re-elected in 2024.
